review_candidates.title: Desktop Support Technician - IT, Level 2

matched_queries.query: Middle East and Africa IT support

review_candidates.description: The Desktop Support Technician plays a vital role in enabling employees to do their best work by ensuring they have reliable technology, responsive support, and a seamless IT experience. We currently have 3 openings, one in London, one Madrid, one Lausanne and one in Warsaw. As the primary IT point of contact for a local office of approximately employees 80 (London), 80 (Madrid), 200 (Lausanne) or 30 (Warsaw). this role combines hands-on technical expertise with exceptional customer service. You will be responsible for troubleshooting hardware and software issues, maintaining and deploying IT equipment, and proactively resolving technical challenges that impact day-to-day operations. Beyond providing support, you'll contribute directly to employee productivity, workplace efficiency, and the overall success of the organization by creating a smooth and dependable technology environment. This is an excellent opportunity for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys building strong relationships with end users, taking ownership of local IT operations, and making a visible impact across the business Nature of Impact High level of customer satisfaction as measured by feedback surveys. Reduced downtime due to efficient troubleshooting and problem resolution. Accurate and up-to-date inventory management. Successful deployment and maintenance of IT equipment. Effective training sessions leading to fewer support requests. Meeting or exceeding SLAs for response and resolution times. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot and resolve hardware and software issues autonomously (Level 2 Desktop Support Technician). Provide a high standard of IT Services Support onsite and remotely. Configure and deploy desktops, laptops, and mobile devices. Provide input on IT strategies and OKRs related to support efficiency. Utilize and contribute to IT support documentation and SOP's. Assist with network connectivity issues. Maintain an accurate inventory of all IT equipment and software licenses. Administer and grant Access Permissions to users. Onboard new starters and deliver IT Inductions. Provide end-user training and support for IT systems and applications. Collaborate with other IT team members to improve support processes. Support and contribute to both internal and external company events. Use JSM (Jira Service Management) ticketing system to communicate with users and provide updates. Ensure all tickets are resolved within defined SLA's (Service Level Agreements). Provide AV support in Meeting Rooms. Requirements 3-5 years of experience in a desktop support or similar role. Associate or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (preferred). Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician) Familiarity with network configurations and protocols. Experience with operating systems (Windows, macOS, iOS). Knowledge of IT security best practices. C1 - C2 English level Benefits We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support) Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub Equal opportunity statement Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

review_candidates.title: Service Desk Analyst / Infrastructure Service Desk Support Associate
review_candidates.description: Job Description Must Have Technical/Functional Skills 1-2 years of hands-on experience in Infrastructure Service Desk / IT helpdesk operations. Experience handling end-user tickets, service requests, incidents, and basic troubleshooting for workplace IT services. Basic understanding of ITIL-based incident management, service request fulfillment, escalation, SLA adherence, and ticket documentation. Working knowledge of Windows desktop/laptop support, Microsoft 365/Office, Outlook/Teams, VPN, password resets, network connectivity, printers, and common end-user applications. Ability to triage incidents, gather required details, follow runbooks/knowledge articles, and route tickets to the correct resolver groups. Strong written and verbal communication skills with proactive status updates to end users and stakeholders. Customer-focused attitude, ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to work in a structured support environment. Roles & Responsibilities Act as first-level point of contact for infrastructure service desk tickets, calls, emails, and user requests. Log, categorize, prioritize, troubleshoot, resolve, or escalate incidents and service requests as per agreed process. Provide timely and proactive status updates to end users until closure, including expected next steps and escalation status. Perform basic troubleshooting for desktop, laptop, Microsoft 365, communication tools, network access, VPN, printer, password, and application access issues. Maintain quality ticket notes, resolution details, knowledge-base references, and handoff information for L2/L3 teams. Follow defined SOPs, runbooks, ITSM workflows, SLA targets, and escalation matrix. Support shift handovers, daily operational status reporting, open-ticket follow-up, and aging-ticket tracking. Contribute to service improvements by identifying recurring issues, updating knowledge articles, and improving user communication templates. Generic Managerial Skills, If any Proactive communication and ability to share clear status updates with end users and internal stakeholders. Good coordination with resolver groups, onsite/offshore teams, and account leadership for pending tickets and escalations. Ability to manage priorities, follow up on open items, and maintain service-desk hygiene in a time-bound manner. Professional customer-service mindset with patience, clarity, and ownership during user interactions. Base Salary Range : $50,000 to $60,000 Per Annum TCS Employee Benefits Summary Discretionary Annual Incentive. Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Medical & Health, Dental & Vision, Disability Planning & Insurance, Pet Insurance Plans. Family Support: Maternal & Parental Leaves. Insurance Options: Auto & Home Insurance, Identity Theft Protection. Convenience & Professional Growth: Commuter Benefits & Certification & Training Reimbursement. Time Off: Vacation, Time Off, Sick Leave & Holidays. Legal & Financial Assistance: Legal Assistance, 401K Plan, Performance Bonus, College Fund, Student Loan Refinancing. Qualifications: BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE
